zh: 1 浪子还在回家的路上，父亲看见了，就跑去迎接他；神对悔改罪人赦免的“脚”也是迅速的；祂只想早一点赦免人的罪—20节。
en: 1.	While the prodigal son was on his way home, the father saw him and ran to meet him; God’s “feet” of forgiveness toward a repentant sinner are also swift; He only wishes He could forgive man of his sins sooner—v. 20.
